title: Degreewise scalar tensor pullback chain square
statement: For finite R, p:X→Y, complexes P,Q and degree n, the two chain maps of the scalar tensor pullback square have equal nth components.

proof.text: Use the proved equality of the original native chain-map composites. Its proof first shows the native cochain diagram commutes by degreewise mapped-coproduct extensionality and complete summand pasting, then reduces its explicit native paths before evaluating degrees.
Apply degree-n evaluation to this equality of the exact native chain maps. The resulting component equality is precisely the original statement, without any alteration of the native constructions.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product, constituents of the signed total isomorphism; mapped-coproduct extensionality and native diagram pasting, with the ordinary scalar square as the sole new mathematical premise.

mathlib_searches.results: Degreewise extensionality is the standard final step.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the component equation to prove the chain-map equality.

theorem finiteScalarTensorPullback_chain_square_component
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    (((((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((finiteScalarFixedComplexTensorPullbackForCoefficients
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).app (P, Q))) ≫
      (finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalRealization R X).app
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P,
         ((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
      (uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)).map₂HomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app P)
          ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app Q))).f n) =
    (((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app
        ((finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalTensor
          (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)))).obj (P, Q)) ≫
      ((proEtaleRingModulePullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
          (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).map ((finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalRealization R Y).app (P, Q)) ≫
      (finiteScalarIntrinsicComplexTensorPullback R p).app
        (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P,
         ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)).f
      n)
